entries.message: Feature - Add isolated personal rating sync
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Add opt-in provider directions, baseline/import modes, conflict policy, and live status controls
Queue local rating changes independently with durable retries and episode-aware identity
Sync personal ratings with Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, and Trakt, including a per-title Force Sync action
Keep watched-state Force Sync separate while exposing Trakt as an explicit Push target
